data.gender_notes: Erminna is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Erminna is derived from the Greek words 'Ermos' meaning strong and 'Nymphe' meaning nymph. In Greek mythology, nymphs were supernatural beings associated with nature, fertility, and water. Erminna embodies the strength and grace of these divine beings. The name Erminna carries the meaning “Strong, Ermos + Nymphe, Nymph” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Erminna usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, ermos + nymphe, nymph and live with faith, good character and purpose.
